### Deviations not yet raised with design

- [Hero Media](components/hero-media.md): Media opacity is opacity/medium (0.48) on a #171717 frame underlay; the Figma node specifies 32% (opacity/mild)
- [InlineBanner](components/inline-banner.md) in akount.ing: Renders label-only; the per-status glyph (plus / alarm / positive / warning) is an optional slot
- [Toggle](components/toggle.md) in akount.ing: Accepts a text label; width grows past 40px to fit it, height stays 40px
- [Toggle](components/toggle.md) in akount.ing: Rendered as role=radio inside a ToggleGroup radio group, which has no surface of its own
